title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from the front at a raised angle. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left (front-left) square; a raised orange disc marks the goal on the top-right (back-right) square. Up moves the token away from you, Down toward you, Left and Right sideways. Hint shows a green arrow from the token toward the goal. Readouts show moves made and steps still to the goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the orange goal square at the top-right.
game.hint: Each move changes the row or the column by one. The goal is 2 rows up and 2 columns right, so the shortest route is 4 moves. Press Hint to see a helpful move.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up moves the token away from the camera (toward the back row), Down toward it. The start and goal are fixed; Reset returns to the same start.
